top_signals.title: S&P 500 Set for All-Time Highs on Hormuz Deal Push: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Hopes for an agreement to revive the Strait of Hormuz lifted stocks toward all-time highs, bonds climbed and oil sank, with Wall Street’s enthusiasm also fueled by a batch of solid corporate earnings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Wayfair Sees Momentum as Stores, High-End Goods Draw Consumers
top_signals.summary: Kate Gulliver, CFO at Wayfair, said that the momentum the furniture company is seeing is the result of initiatives building up over time as Wayfair tries to improve the customer experience. Gulliver also discussed what kind of consumers are buying from Wayfair. She said that the company is seeing momentum from the higher-end consumer with the inclusion of a premium brand 'Perigold' and is drawing in new customers with brick-and-mortar stores.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US Army wants a surface-to-air missile that can destroy small drones
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Army wants new surface-to-air missiles, costing less than $150,000 apiece, that can destroy small drones.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cloudflare kicks off stablecoin wallet rollout for AI agents to pay for APIs and online content
top_signals.summary: Users can claim Cloudflare wallet handles now, while funding and payment features will arrive later.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Jefferies Gets New Evidence of Fake Invoices at Troubled Fund
top_signals.summary: Jeffries has found new evidence that invoices underpinning its financing to an iron ore trader called Sapphire Minmetals Corp. are fake. This discovery comes after Jeffries was already reviewing its exposure to iron ore trader Radiant World, after reports that documents provided to financers were not valid. Bloomberg's Sri Natarajan reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Sorry everyone, Bitcoin is headed down to $43,500: Michael Terpin
top_signals.summary: Transform Ventures founder Michael Terpin says Bitcoin could have another 30% downside from its current price before he is confident the market has reached a bottom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
